name: Killer Night

features.name: Expanding wild multipliers
features.description: Wilds stretch to cover 2–5 positions and can carry up to 10x, multiplying together in the same win.

features.name: Sticky merging wilds
features.description: In free spins all wilds stay put, and a new wild landing next to one merges with it and adds the multipliers.

features.name: Super free spins
features.description: A super scatter in the trigger starts a version where at least three expanding wilds land on the first spin.

review:
An 80s slasher-movie game built on expanding wilds. Any wild can stretch to cover two to five spots and carry a multiplier up to 10x – and several in one win multiply together rather than add.

Three to five scatters give 10 to 20 free spins where every wild sticks all round, and a new wild landing directly above or below a sticky one merges with it, adding multipliers. A super scatter starts super free spins with at least three wilds on the first spin. 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
